name: Texal
author: superhac
description: A copper-lit list of tables beside a framed preview, with the backglass behind it all.
change_log: Rebuilt for VPinFE 3.0: core now handles input, audio, preloading, layout, the loading indicator, attract mode and the backglass and score view pages, so the theme is one playfield page. New option: Show the flyer, which also shows a panel of your own stats for the table. The community rating from VPinPlay shows beside the title when a table has one.
